newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian shares ease after hitting new life high.
newsitem.headline: Austrian shares ease after hitting new life high.

text.p: 1330 GMT - Austrian shares close lower after investors move in to take profits following strong advances in early trading, which briefly pushed ATX index to new life high of 1,270.42 in heavy volume.
Traders say short-time outlook depends on whether follow-up orders materialise, with some saying a correction is in store.
* ATX index down 3.27 points or 0.26 percent at 1,256.17

* Top gainer Creditanstalt preference shares ahead of expected news this week on an exchange offer for Creditanstalt holders by Bank Austria, which took over its competitor in January. Share gains 5.37 percent to 483.65 ATS.
* Top loser AMS, dow 2.28 pct at 920 ATS
* ATX May futures down 7.1 points at 1,251.9 -- Vienna newsroom, +431 53112 274
